mapper.select: SELECT registrable_stock_id AS registrableStockId, general_account_id AS generalAccountId, foreign_product_id AS foreignProductId, held_qty AS heldQty, source_broker AS sourceBroker, recorded_at AS recordedAt, purchase_date AS purchaseDate, purchase_price AS purchasePrice, purchase_currency AS purchaseCurrency, purchase_fx_rate AS purchaseFxRate FROM registrable_stock WHERE general_account_id = #{generalAccountId} AND foreign_product_id = #{foreignProductId}
